_comment: HOLDINGS. 'qty' goes into column F, 'avg' into column H. Set 'avg' to null if you don't track a cost basis — the I/J change formulas are then left blank rather than showing #DIV/0!. ETFS: authoritative. An ETF screenshot shows a price but never a share count, so the server injects 'qty' from here and overrides anything the model guesses — UPDATE THIS FILE whenever you buy or sell, then push (Vercel redeploys automatically). FX: FALLBACK ONLY. The multi-currency screenshot is the source of truth for both which currencies exist and how much of each is held, so the 'fx' amounts below are used only when a week has no such screenshot, and the preview flags any currency whose screenshot figure differs from them. A currency here that the screenshot omits gets no row that week; a currency the screenshot shows that is missing here gets a row with no cost basis. Keeping this section current still matters — it is the fallback, and 'avg' (IDR per unit at cost) lives nowhere else. Currencies the BCA Forex Pocket lists at 0.00 (EUR, GBP) are not holdings and do not belong here.
